info.title: Regime Card: market regime and risk-on / risk-off API
info.summary: A market regime and market risk check for AI agents. Pay per call in USDC over x402, or connect the MCP server. No account, no API key.
info.description: Is the US market risk-on or risk-off right now? Regime Card reads eight cross-asset signals (credit, volatility, rates, currencies, commodities, sectors) and answers with one score from 0 to 100 and one of five market regimes, from Risk-Off to Risk-On. Agents use it as a market conditions check, a macro signal, or a risk check before a trade. Also: the stress gate, and how a stock or crypto has typically done in markets like today's. Pay per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana over x402. No account, no API key.
info.x-guidance: Regime Card describes US market conditions: a score from 0 (most risk-off) to 100 (most risk-on), one of five regimes, a stress gate, and how stocks and coins have typically done in the current regime. Start with the free sample. Paid calls cost a few cents in USDC over x402 and return data only after the payment settles. Every response says whether it is live or settled. It describes conditions and is not investment advice.

get.summary: Get the live US market regime reading: risk-on or risk-off
get.description: Is the US market risk-on or risk-off right now? Returns the live Regime Card reading: a score from 0 (most risk-off) to 100 (most risk-on) and one of five market regimes, from Risk-Off to Risk-On, built from eight cross-asset signals, beside the last settled close. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Recomputed hourly during the US session (10:00 AM to 4:00 PM ET) and marked "live". Outside the session it returns the settled reading, marked "settled". Useful when an agent needs a market sentiment or market conditions check for today, or a fear and greed alternative that reads credit, volatility, rates, currencies, commodities and sectors.

get.summary: Check whether it is time to reduce risk or hedge: credit, volatility and rate stress
get.description: Is it time to reduce risk or hedge? Credit, volatility and rate stress in one call. Returns the Regime Card stress gate: the overall state (Calm, Elevated or Stressed), how many of its three components are confirmed (N of 3), and the state of each component (Credit, Volatility, Rates: Clear or Confirmed). The levels behind the states stay private. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Recomputed hourly during the US session. "stale" is true when a scheduled update is missing. Useful when an agent needs a market stress or market risk check on credit, volatility and rates before it acts.

post.summary: Fetch one stock or crypto symbol's returns by market regime
post.description: How has this stock or crypto typically done in markets like today's? Returns, for one stock or crypto symbol per call (any US stock, plus the covered crypto list), its typical return and how often it rose over 1 to 12 months from the current regime. Stocks add sensitivity versus the S&P 500 and up to 5 peer symbols. A symbol with no price data is free, not covered. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Settled figures, updated after each US close (coins daily). The same figures as the symbol's page on regimecard.com. Useful when an agent needs stock returns by market regime or crypto returns by market regime for one holding.

200.description: Returns, for one stock or crypto symbol per call (any US stock, plus the covered crypto list), its typical return and how often it rose over 1 to 12 months from the current regime. get.summary: Get the market regime for crypto across BTC and altcoins
get.description: Is crypto risk-on or risk-off, and what does bitcoin risk look like in markets like today's? Returns the current crypto market regime and each covered coin's typical return and how often it rose over 1, 2 and 3 months when the period started in this regime, as historical odds. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Regime updates after each US close, coins once a day. Useful when an agent needs the market regime for crypto across BTC and altcoins. Covers altcoin risk as well as bitcoin.

get.summary: Get the market regime, stress gate and scorecard in one call
get.description: What is the stock market today, in one call? Returns the live market regime reading, the stress gate, and the scorecard row for the regime of the last settled close: what the S&P 500 did in the 5 and 20 trading days after past readings in that regime (typical return, how often it rose, a bad outcome as a drawdown risk measure). The scorecard follows the settled reading, so during a session its regime can differ from the live reading's. A cross-asset macro signal. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Recomputed hourly during the US session. Useful when an agent wants one reading as a risk check before a trade or as a position sizing input.

The scorecard follows the settled reading, so during a session its regime can differ from the live reading's. A cross-asset macro signal.
